limitations: This analysis rereads and recomputes results from complete saved summary tables; it does not rerun DES, tick checker or 744 individual value traces. Every saved audit flag/output count was checked; raw full traces are not in these summary receipts, so their SHA256 values cannot independently authenticate unavailable raw bytes.
The zero-contention estimator is a dependency/declared-latency lower bound, omitting resource initiation intervals and within-packet serialization.
26 points evaluate six frozen witnesses only. Exact plans p0024/p0072 were not included in witness parameter replay; no robustness claim for the nominal exact ranking follows.
All deltas are model ticks. final_ack is the maximum transaction completion-observed event including observation costs, not merely last ACK-flit arrival.
No Hcompiler, strong P0 portfolio qualification, M2, full MLP performance, native hardware or NPE cross-tool result is established.
method: Independent Cartesian construction, SHA256/canonical JSON checks, set/count and row invariant checks, direct min/tie-set arithmetic, all registered pair differences, and independent service=bytes/(24*eta_d) and link=flits*ticks identities. Does not import run_micro, its ranking/ledger helpers, or either execution engine.
